sources.title: laion/moss-va-sft3-voice-loras · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 500 voice adapters for MOSS voice-acting v2 SFT-3 One rank-16 LoRA per synthetic voice profile. Each is trained on every clip of that one voice — about 2,150 rows after dropping the worst decile by measured quality — across all emotions and all VoiceNet dimensions.

sources.title: VoiceNet LoRA evolution - projects.laion.ai
sources.snippet: For each new VoiceNet-dimension LoRA (retrained with ≤25% game-character data), a 10-generation evolutionary search finds the prompt+sampling that best pushes its dimension, then measures the effect at 0% / 50% / 100% strength. Shows what each LoRA brings, how 50% compares to 100%, and the best way to prompt it. Fitness = mean over 6 candidates of the dimension in its intended direction ...

sources.title: GitHub - LAION-AI/moss-voicenet-manual: MOSS-VA-v2 VoiceNet dimension ...
sources.snippet: For each dimension, both the __high and __low LoRA are swept at 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125%. Each page reports: the dose-response of the measured target score, the cost in genuineness / vocal-burst blend / speech quality, the top-3 ± correlated EmoNet emotions and VoiceNet dimensions, three audio samples per dose, and a grounded prompting tip.
